text:
julie: FYI Purchaserly hitting ~15% 503s on dedicated pool us-west-2 since 2026-03-18T10:10:00PT. Error pattern: long tail timeouts at inference routing. @maria @devin can you triage? customer asking for ETA, they have a live promo.

sre-bot: Alert: svc/purchaserly-dedicated - 5xx rate increase 2026-03-18 17:10Z. p99 latency 2.1s -> 4.8s. Link: https://redwood.metrics/alerts/ALRT-4567 :rotating_light:

maria: On it. grabbing logs & routing table. prob related to new routing policy (cost-tier fallback) we rolled yesterday. will confirm in 10m.

devin: I can look at runtime kernels and batching. can you drop the customer request id? also pinging @ani for temporary routing flip.

kevin: From CS: Customer expects fix within 2h or they escalate to legal. They've already disabled heavy features client-side. Please keep me updated.

maria: quick find: requests for purchaserly are being routed to model-7-q4 (quantized) and hitting an OOM fallback loop, failing to fall back gracefully. here's excerpt from logs:
```
2026-03-18T17:11:02Z ERROR router: model variant model-7-q4 OOM, proxy_drop
2026-03-18T17:11:02Z WARN cache: failed to restore kvcache, retry
```

maria: Temporary mitigations: 1) pin their route to model-7-fp16 in us-west-2 2) disable cost-tier fallback policy for their account 3) increase pool headroom. I can do 1 & 2 now if owners agree.

ani: I can flip the route to model-7-fp16 via feature-flag toggle. command:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/routing/toggle -d '{"account":"purchaserly","route":"model-7-fp16"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```
I'll run canary 1% -> 10% then 100% if green. Need someone to monitor logs & CR for quick rollback.

devin: I'll watch runtime & kernel OOMs. If we need a code fix, I can prepare a revert PR for the routing change in ~45m. ping @maria for CR review when ready.

maria: I'll monitor metrics dashboard and confirm p99 drop. starting canary now.

julie: Ani please proceed with canary. Devin/maria stand by for rollback. Kevin, I'll tell customer we expect mitigation in ~30-45m, escalate to 2h if not resolved. :thumbsup:

kevin: Customer OK with canary timeline, wants status update at +30m.

sre-bot: Canary update: 1% -> 10% completed. error-rate on canary nodes 0.9% vs 15% baseline. continuing.

maria: Canary at 10% looks good. p99 down to 1.2s. Recommend promote to 100% now.

ani: Promoting to 100% now.

sre-bot: Promotion complete. Global error rate back to 0.8%. No new OOMs detected.

julie: Thanks everyone — owners: ani (routing flip), devin (runtime follow-up), maria (monitor & post-mortem). Kevin will coordinate customer comms. Follow up PRs: devin will open revert/patch; maria will drop postmortem notes. Anyone object to closing this thread?

kevin: All good from CS side, please add customer message draft in #customer-success when you have it.

devin: Will open PR and tag @maria for review within 45m.

maria: I'll assemble postmortem draft by EOD and include root cause + next steps (fix fallback behavior & better canary checks).

julie: Closing here — if anything regresses ping @oncall. Good work. :tada:
